assumptions.lift_extension_permission: Owner considers 644 x 1444 mm excessive; expanded lift footprint is not accepted. Current rotor layouts remain comparison evidence while compact layout and mass reduction are investigated.
assumptions.dusting_target: Owner reports ceiling fans about 7 ft (2133.6 mm) above floor and 1 ft (304.8 mm) below ceiling; about 2 ft (609.6 mm) duster reach is desired. Reach datum and fan blade geometry remain to detail. Earlier 2 m / 300 mm shelf assumption is superseded.
assumptions.purchase_policy: No new purchases or print release from this paper design.
assumptions.mass_ranges: Low/nominal/high engineering allowances, not confidence intervals. All combinations include only one bottom and one top.
assumptions.guard_factor: 0.75 baseline retained thrust at equal electrical operating point; sensitivity 0.65–0.85. Not measured guard performance.
assumptions.flight_voltage: 21 V under-load screening case; scaled maximum thrust is an estimate, not manufacturer low-voltage data.
assumptions.battery_exchange: Owner requires automatic cartridge exchange and charged station spares. Initial allocation: two spare packs and four rack bays per floor; one pack carried, five packs across two floors. Counts are design assumptions, not purchases or a no-wait guarantee.

vacuum.label: Everyday vacuum / drive
vacuum.payload_note: 0.50 L usable bin target; 150 g design debris load, 300 g stress case; mass checked at dock before lift.

mop.label: Oscillating mop / drive
mop.payload_note: 350 mL clean water plus 50 g pad water; high case allows 100 g wet pad. Dirty water stays in station.

low.label: Under-sofa vacuum / drive
low.payload_note: 0.30 L bin target. Head has 60 mm stowed front overhang; extension is an explicit envelope exception.

dust.label: Extended duster / drive
dust.payload_note: Higher shelves require the lift top. Head and guide stow before transfer; contact-flight qualification is open.

drive_loads.name: Two wheel motors at cleaning load
Bottom control, sensors and driver losses

mop.name: Lift and wet control duty average

power.notes: Normal/high loads are design scenarios, not measured consumption. High is a simultaneous operating allocation, not unrestricted motor stall. Conversion losses counted once at the rail boundary.

lift.notes: Non-coaxial layout keeps the propeller disks clear of the core. Eight motors require a geometry-specific allocator; this is not a stock Octo-X frame. Existing 8S pack cannot power this 4–6S motor reference. The default identifies the previous accounting comparison, not a selected production top. Its long two-column arrangement is not a minimum-size proof.

station.notes: Five complete-bottom positions: local tool inventory plus receiving vacancy. Intact rotor top parks overhead. Station stock, water and machinery are not carried. Four battery bays hold two resident spares, one returning-pack vacancy and one recovery vacancy. Spare packs are excluded from carried robot mass. Cabinet/top storage dimensions inherit the oversized lift comparison and must be reconsidered with its replacement; they are not an accepted household footprint.

battery_exchange.status: Preliminary automatic exchange design; no fabrication or electrical release
battery_exchange.charge_rate_status: Arithmetic illustration only; use the selected pack manufacturer limit and measured temperatures
battery_exchange.ready_policy: Target both resident spares charged while station enabled. Charge terminates; no continuous trickle. Revalidate voltage, cell balance, temperature and task capability before reservation.
battery_exchange.notes: Never parallel packs or remove a live propulsion connection. A mission needs reachable station energy reserve and a compatible READY pack. Shared charging power, cooling and taper can still create waits.

dusting_requirements.reach_datum_status: Nominal tool reach reported; body-edge versus guard-edge datum unresolved. Do not add hidden rotor stand-off to this requirement.
dusting_requirements.fan_state_for_cleaning: Off, stopped and prevented from restarting during contact; autonomy interface not yet designed
dusting_requirements.notes: Current shared 1 m horizontal telescope is retained as earlier geometry/mass evidence. Fan cleaning needs revised approach and upward articulation or another access mechanism. The under-sofa 914.4 mm depth requirement is unchanged.

configured_support.status: Mechanism and support candidates; G remains the complete mass/layout baseline

wheel.note: Rear-mounted pivot gives a leading arm, not a trailing arm. Loads are preliminary design cases, not motor-shaft or bushing ratings. Full droop is a candidate to screen, not an adopted height-compatible setting.

caster.note: The bare L51-8 caster needs a separate retained fitting. 2.5 mm is a sensitivity/reference assumption, not a verified height for an ordered fitting; do not put a generic M8 bolt into its blind bore.

material.note: Same 6061-T6 assumption and preliminary project bending limit as G; supplied stock, holes and joints require qualification.

carrier.note: Stock routes only. Inner rails, pivot-cap joints, rear tie-to-side-frame joints, coupling-stud attachments and fasteners must close before replacing F. Do not install overlapping candidate and F supports.

motor_load_guidance.note: Manufacturer gearbox-load guidance, not the older 25%-of-stall-torque estimate. Retain the lower applicable gearbox and motor thermal limit.

optics.scope: Ground cap and core vertical clearance only. Lift frame, connector cable loops, window covers and complete optical cone remain unqualified.

caster_beam.scope: Gross 40 x 3 mm strip, rigid root, 100 N vertical plus 25 N fore/aft. Holes, bolted root and caster plug retention unqualified.
